beats.event: Orphaned Jane lives at Gateshead under a cruel aunt and bullying cousin
Locked in the red room where her uncle died; faints in terror
Sent to Lowood School; cold rooms, poor food, harsh discipline
Her friend Helen Burns dies of consumption in her arms
Six years a pupil, two a teacher; she advertises for a new post
Becomes governess at Thornfield Hall to Adèle Varens
On an icy lane she helps a fallen horseman; her master Mr Rochester
Saves Rochester from a mysterious fire in his bedroom at night
The beautiful Blanche Ingram arrives; Jane feels invisible
At the altar the wedding is stopped: he already has a mad wife, Bertha, in the attic
Jane flees Thornfield at dawn with almost nothing
Wanders the moors, loses her bundle, collapses starving on a doorstep
St John Rivers takes her in; finds her a village-school post
Learns her uncle has left her twenty thousand pounds; the Rivers are her cousins
Refuses St John's loveless missionary marriage proposal
Seems to hear Rochester's voice calling her name; sets out for Thornfield
Finds Thornfield burned; Bertha dead; Rochester blind and maimed
Reunited at Ferndean; Reader, I married him
